Commentary.Commentary: That brings us to the close of the 2nd ODI. The Men in Blue showed good character and temperament to keep the series alive. On the other hand, New Zealand were not good enough today. They will know that they have the potential to surprise oppositions in the sub-continent and will be eager to learn from their mistakes. Join us for the decider on 29th October in Kanpur at 1330 local time (0800 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, adios and take care!

Man of the Match, Bhuvneshwar Kumar says that his nature is calm and composed and he sticks to the basics. Mentions that he focuses on swinging the ball but it wasn't happening today. Adds that he bowled in the right areas and it worked out for him. Opines that he is growing in confidence and thanks the team management for backing him. Feels that he is not a muscular guy but he has worked very hard on his fitness.

Victorious India skipper, Virat Kohli says that it was a good game for them. Adds that the wicket played slower in the first half and got better under lights as expected. Praises his bowlers and fielders for their performance. Credits his new ball bowlers for bowling in a disciplined manner. Adds that they got wickets through good deliveries. Mentions that Dhawan is striking the ball well and stitched useful partnerships in the middle. States that they look forward to challenges. He is happy that they have bounced back and will aim to play similar cricket in Kanpur.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson says that on this surface, 230 was not enough. Mentions that you need to play well irrespective of winning or losing the toss. Credits India for pacing their chase well. States the track was not easy to play on but de Grandhomme batted really fluently. Informs that they had put a much better performance in Mumbai. Ends by saying that they will look to bounce back hard in the decider in Kanpur.

Earlier, the home side kept on taking wickets on a consistent basis and didn't let the opposition flourish at all. The Kiwi batsmen got starts but failed to make something substantial out of it. The hosts' bowlers were on the money and it was a collective performance from them. Special mention must go to Kumar and Bumrah who combined to pick up 5 wickets for 83 in their 20 overs. In the end, it was a below par score which the Men in Blue got past with consummate ease.

Dhawan stitched another vital stand with Karthik keeping India ahead. The southpaw missed out on a ton but he did his job for his side. Pandya who was promoted up the order played a breezy knock while Karthik batted sensibly from the other end, going past a half century. New Zealand tried really hard but didn't have enough to play with on a track which got better for batting under lights. Santner was the pick of the bowlers, picked up a wicket and kept the run flow in check but he didn't get enough support.

A brilliant performance from India to level the series 1-1 and this is also their 50th victory over New Zealand in ODI cricket. They paced the chase really well and came out on top with flying colours. Rohit Sharma departed cheaply once again but Dhawan and Kohli played some eye-catching strokes to keep India on course. The Indian skipper failed to get going and threw his wicket away courtesy a loose shot but the home side kept calm.

FOUR! Convincing way to seal the game for his country! Fullish delivery outside off, Karthik strides forward and creams it elegantly through covers to find the fence. He is all smiles and so is Dhoni. A clinical show from the Men in Blue to bounce back in style. INDIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS!
Fuller in length around off, MS Dhoni walks down the track and eases it to mid on for a brisk single.
Good length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, Dhoni hangs back and flat-bats it to mid off.
Leg bye! Angling down towards the hips, Dinesh looks to tuck it across but the ball brushes his pads and rolls towards short fine leg. A single taken.
Full length ball on middle and leg, MS clips it to deep mid-wicket for an easy single.
Southee hits the deck hard and bowls it outside off. Dhoni frees his arms and goes for the cut but fails to connect. India only a hit away from a win.
Shortish delivery well outside off, Karthik cuts it hard but the fielder at point dives to stop it.
Fractionally overpitched on off, Dhoni leans into it and drives it to mid on for a swift single.
Milne bowls this one at a slower pace around off, MS reads it well and strokes it to the same region. 4 dot balls in a row, the crowd is getting a bit restless.
Back of a length delivery in the off stump channel, Dhoni with minimal foot movement punches it on the up to covers.
Similar length delivery outside off, MS Dhoni pushes it off the back foot to cover-point.
Length delivery on off, Dhoni hangs back and play it with a vertical bat to the mid off fielder.
Adam Milne comes back for a bowl. This might be the last over of the game.
Angling in substantially from around off, Karthik looks to keep it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Beaten! Shortish delivery around off, Karthik goes for the cut but misses. That was too close for that shot.
Boult comes around the wicket and angles it on a good length from outside off. Dhoni waits for it and runs it down to third man for a run.
Fullish ball around off, eased to covers off the front foot.
FOUR! This one is much more convincing. Length delivery outside off, Dhoni punches this one on the up through covers and the ball whistles away to the fence. India need 8 more runs for a victory.

FOUR! Not off the meat of the bat but Dhoni will be pleased with the result. Fuller in length around off, Dhoni moves across and heaves it off the bottom half of the bat towards wide mid on. The fielder there dives to his right but the ball goes past him and through to the fence.
Good running! Karthik whips this one to wide long on for a run. He calls Dhoni through for the second as the fielder has some ground to cover to his right. Two runs taken safely in the end.
Dhoni walks down the track to the tossed up delivery and knocks it down to long on to rotate strike.
Drifting towards the pads, tucked through square leg for an easy run.
Goes back to the shorter delivery and steers it to point.
Floated around off, played with soft hands to short extra cover.
Quicker through the air around off, Karthik leans forward to defend it but gets beaten by the lack of turn. Latham whips off the bails but Dinesh has his back foot planted within the crease.
On a length outside off, Dhoni doesn't fiddle with it.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Full and on the boots, Dhoni moves inside the line and whips it in front of square leg. The timing is spot on and MS gets the desired result.
Good length delivery, defended solidly off the back foot.
Play and a miss! Shorter in length and width on offer, Dhoni slashes at it but gets beaten.
Bit wider outside off this time, Dhoni is not induced into playing it and remains composed in leaving it.
In the zone outside off, angling away from Dhoni who lifts his bat skywards and lets it go.
Trent Boult returns for a bowl. Can he do something spectacular here and breathe life back into the contest?
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Tossed up delivery, Dinesh looks to clip it across but gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Fraction short, Karthik cuts it through point for a brace.
Coming in with the arm, defended beside the pitch on the leg side.
Dhoni uses his feet and chips it to long off for a run and gets off the mark.
MS Dhoni walks out to the middle. India need 27 runs from 59 balls.

OUT! Pandya departs! He would be unhappy that he has failed to take his side over the finishing line. Juicy full toss on middle, Pandya looks to paddle sweep it but hits it straight to Milne at backward square leg who pouches it safely. Hardik usually doesn't play the sweep much and he departs attempting it. End of a decent knock from the all-rounder.
Time for Powerplay 3. Maximum of five fielders allowed outside the circle till the end of the innings. However, New Zealand need to attack at this stage.
Pandya strokes this one through the same region for a run.
Fullish delivery, eased through mid off for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Back of a length outside off, steered to third man for a run.

FOUR! 9th ODI fifty for Karthik! It has been a measured knock from him and very well deserved. Making his opportunities count. Short and room on offer, Karthik pounces on it and flashes it past the point region for a rocketing boundary.

Angling into the pads, Karthik turns it around the corner for a run. The 50-run stand comes up between the two. Good batting from these two. They would be eager to guide their side over the finishing line.
Colin de Gradhomme comes back into the attack. Williamson is shuffling around his bowlers. The visitors need to do something magical or else this game will be shut for them.
Full and wide outside off, inviting Pandya to drive. He does so but finds Guptill at short extra cover.
Slow through the air, pushed back to Santner.
Fullish delivery, Dinesh milks it down to long on to get off strike. India doing it easily at the moment.
Stays back to this one and punches it back to the bowler.
Short and flat on leg stump, Pandya flat-bats it to long on to rotate strike.
Leg bye! Drifting down the leg side, Karthik tries to flick it but the ball kisses his pads and rolls to short fine leg. A single taken.
Mitchell Santner to roll his arm over again.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Karthik strokes it past extra cover for a single.
Short delivery, Pandya pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Good game awareness! Pandya works the length delivery to square leg and calls for the second. By the time the fielder gets to it, Pandya makes his ground with ease.
FOUR! Well played! Back of a length ball well outside off, Pandya places it expertly between the gap between point and cover-point and picks up back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! Hit with disdain! Scrambled seam delivery on a short length around off, Pandya shuffles a bit and pulls it through backward square leg. Boult at long leg runs to his left but decides to give up the chase.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Karthik moves inside the line and helps it down to fine leg for a brace.
Short delivery on leg stump, Karthik pulls it over square leg for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short of a length outside off, dabbed past backward point for a run.
Similar length delivery outside off, Dinesh cuts it past point to rotate strike.

Good judgement! Good length delivery outside off, Karthik glides it down to third man for a single. Southee has been brought in that position and he runs to his right. There is a fumble from him and that is good enough for the batsmen to come back for the second.
Wide! Full length delivery down the leg side, Karthik tries to whip it away but misses.
Back of a length ball, slanting across the right-hander. He slaps it hard but straight to the man at backward point. There is no third man in place and that is why he is eyeing that region.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Karthik runs it down to third man for a run and will retain strike.
Back of a length outside off, Dinesh stays back and punches it to the point region.
Short delivery on middle, sits up nicely for Pandya. He pulls it hard over deep mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

Brilliant effort, Boult! Such an effort can lift the morale of the entire side. On the hips, Karthik helps it down to fine leg for a run. The batsmen line up for the second run but Boult is really quick to attack the ball. Returns an accurate throw to the keeper which denies the batsmen to risk it.
Tight run! On a length on middle and leg, Pandya taps it in front of mid on and crosses over for a brisk single.
Tim Southee returns for a burst.
The batsman plays the pull shot.
Sharp bouncer this time, Dinesh ducks under it.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Back of a length outside off, slapped to the man straight at point.
Short delivery on middle and leg, pulled through square leg for a couple.
Good length ball on middle and leg, pushed off the back foot to the bowler.
Trent Boult is back on. The game is slipping out of New Zealand's hands.
Stays back to this one and defends it. End of a testing over from Milne.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Nervy moment! Back of a length delivery around off, Pandya goes for a punch through the line with minimal foot movement and mistimes it towards Santner at covers. He dives in front but the ball falls just short of him.
Back of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a run.

A loud appeal turned down! Back of a length delivery on middle, angling down. Karthik looks to clip it away but is hit on the thigh pad. Milne appeals confidently but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show that it was pretty high and would have gone over the stumps.

Karthik is safe! Length delivery on middle and leg, Karthik tucks it through square leg. The fielder in the deep comes running in and returns a fast and accurate throw to Latham as the batsmen go for the second run. Karthik dives in full length as the wicket-keeper takes the bails off. Time for the replays. They show that the dive has saved Dinesh.
Close! Must be touch and go. Brilliant throw from the deep, is Karthik short of his crease?

Drinks time. Meanwhile, there is a bit of confusion about who should be on strike. Karthik and Pandya share a light moment with the umpires. The issue has been sorted and the right man is on strike now.
Flighted this time, Pandya makes room and strokes it to covers.
SIX! Brilliant shot! Tossed up well outside off, Pandya extends his arms and lifts it against the spin over long on for a maximum. He fancies left-arm spinners and we can see once again why.
Karthik strokes this one with the spin through covers for a run.
Uppish but safe! Karthik hurries into this one and gets it off the outer half towards short extra cover.
Floated delivery, eased to long off for a single.
Tossed up delivery, Pandya is early into his clip and gets a leading edge to covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Poor shot! Good length delivery just outside off, Pandya goes for an ambitious punch through the line but gets beaten.
On a length outside off, Hardik punches it through extra cover for a brace.
Wide! Short delivery on off, Pandya arches back and is in two minds. Goes for the ramp eventually but it is too high to execute it. Wide signaled for height.
Leg bye! Angling into the hips, Karthik looks to help it around the corner but the ball brushes his thigh pad and rolls to fine leg. A run taken.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Short and width on offer, Pandya slaps it but straight to Guptill at point.
Tossed up delivery, Pandya drives it down to long off for a run. 2 from this one. Good bowling from the visitors.
Drifting down the leg side, Pandya looks to keep it out but is hit on the pads.
Low full toss on off, Karthik drives it through wide mid on for a single.
Beaten! Third dot ball in a row, pressure is building up. Tossed up on off, spinning away. Karthik goes for a drive but gets foxed.
Full on off, Dinesh jams it back to the bowler.
Coming in with the arm, tucked to short mid-wicket.
Makes room to the back of the length delivery and places it to backward point. A wicket maiden for New Zealand. They need to keep picking up wickets.
Length delivery, angling in. Pandya stands back and answers it with a straight bat.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Pandya doesn't fiddle with it.
Stays back to the back of the length delivery and taps it to point.
Hardik Pandya is the new man in. He has been promoted up the order. Can he play an innings of substance?

OUT! Dhawan misses out on a century! Good length delivery outside off, Shikhar uses his feet and looks to go over extra cover but the bat turns in his hands. Hence, he ends up mistiming it to Ross Taylor in the same region who gobbles it up with ease. The century was there for the taking and the southpaw will be a little disappointed. He slowed down after Powerplay 1, might have got bogged down a touch. The steady 66-run stand comes to an end. Can the Kiwis build on this?
Full length ball on off, drilled straight to the man at mid off who is standing at the edge of the circle.
Adam Milne returns for a bowl. New Zealand need wickets desperately.
Drifting down the leg side, Dinesh tickles it past the keeper. Southee hares after it from short fine leg and keeps it down to a couple.
Plays this one with the angle to the leg side.
Errs in line and drifts down the leg side, turned to backward square leg for a single.
Slow through the air outside off, Karthik punches it on the up past the diving cover fielder for a run.
Coming in with the arm, Karthik tucks it to the man at mid-wicket.
On the pads, helped to short fine leg for a run.
In the zone of apprehension, holding its line. Karthik points his bat skywards to let it be.
Slower delivery on a shorter length, Dhawan pulls it nicely to short fine leg for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Good length delivery, Karthik looks to clip it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

A huge shout for an LBW denied! Back of a length around off, seaming in substantially. Karthik looks to work it around the corner but is struck on the thigh pad. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. New Zealand do not have a review left. Height was the factor there.
Short delivery, Dhawan hammers it to deep square leg for a run.
Change of gloves for Dinesh Karthik.
Around off, spinning away. Karthik plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Slanting down the leg side, Dhawan works it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Full length delivery in line of the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Fuller in length outside off, tapped with an open face to point.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, pushed off the front foot back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Low full toss on off, Dhawan jams it out through mid on for a single. 8 from the over.
Dhawan drops the fullish delivery to short cover and looks to steal a single but it is not on.

SIX! What a hit! Good length delivery around off, in the arc for Dhawan. He stands his ground and hammers it with a strong bottom hand over wide long on for a maximum. That was struck very powerfully. The 50-run stand comes up between the duo. Sensible going from them.
Length delivery angling in from outside off, Dhawan tucks it to short mid-wicket this time. New Zealand need to bowl more of the dot deliveries.
Slower delivery around off, Shikhar reads it well and pats it to mid on.
Fullish on middle and leg, Karthik flicks it through square leg to get off strike.
Tim Southee returns for a bowl. Williamson has turned back to his frontline bowler to break this flourishing partnership.
Aggression from Santner! Shikhar chips down the track and drives it back to Santner. He collects it and fires a direct hit at the striker's end. Dhawan had to move away quickly to evade it.

In the air... but safe! Dhawan uses his feet to the tossed up delivery but is deceived in the flight. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball falls down safely in the vacant short leg region. Latham didn't have much time to react.
Tossed up delivery, Shikhar plays it uppishly but on the bounce to Guptill at short mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Dhawan uses his feet and chips it down to wide long on for a run.
Plays this one with the angle to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Santner to roll his arm over now.
Too straight this time, tucked around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Well placed! Full delivery well outside off, Karthik drives it with an open face past the diving Guptill at point to find the fence.
Dhawan punches this one to sweeper cover for a run.

Tight one! Short and room on offer, Dhawan slaps it to deep point and sets off. He calls for the second and is running to the danger end. Nicholls runs to his right and slides to pick up the ball. Henry returns an accurate throw from the deep to Latham as Dhawan dives full length to get back in. Don't need to risk those when you are on track.
Full length delivery, Shikhar taps it back to the bowler.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On the pads, Dinesh tucks it to fine leg for a run and will retain strike.

Three Wides! Munro comes around the wicket and bowls it down the leg side, Karthik has a whip at it but misses. Latham fails to connect it. Boult from fine leg runs across to it and dives to throw it back to Milne. Good tag team effort. Two runs taken.
Walks into this one and taps it to mid on for a quick run.
Fullish delivery well outside off, Dinesh places it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller in length delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.

22nd ODI fifty for Shikhar Dhawan! It has been a free-flowing knock from him and he will be eyeing to convert it into a big one. He moves across to the length delivery and works it to mid-wicket. The fielder attacks the ball and throws it at the striker's end but Karthik dives in well.
On the pads, Dinesh helps it through square leg for a run.
Almost chopped that back! Good length ball outside off, Dhawan looks to force it through covers but gets an inside edge onto his pads and towards the keeper. Nervy moment on 49.
Down the leg side, nudged across the corner for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Shikhar eases it down through mid on for an easy run.
Shaping in substantially from outside off, Dhawan looks to play it with an angled blade but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Similar length delivery, Shikhar blocks it stoutly.
On a length around off, Dhawan hangs back and punches it to cover-point.
Stays back to the length delivery and punches it through covers for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.

What happened there? Length delivery slanting across Karthik who goes for a wild heave across the line but misses. He straightaway looks at the square leg umpire expecting a no ball as he thought there were only three fielders inside the ring. However, he realizes there were four fielders and apologizes.
Fullish delivery, eased to long on for a run.
Stays back to this one and punches it nicely.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

Not Out! No, he hasn't got a wicket. Munro starts off with a length delivery down the leg side, Dhawan kneels and looks to sweep it hard but seems to have missed it.  Latham collects it nicely and goes up in an appeal along with Munro. The umpire decides to rule it out after a thought. Shikhar straightaway challenges the decision. The replays roll in and they show clear daylight between bat and ball. The decision is overturned. Wide is also signaled.
Has the part-time bowler picked up a wicket? Dhawan has been caught down the leg side but he has gone for the review. He looks confident though.
Colin Munro comes for a bowl. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Length delivery outside off, Dhawan drills it to sweeper cover for a run. 100 up for India.
Shaping in substantially from outside off, Shikhar looks to open up the off side but is cramped for room. Ends up blocking it.
Too straight on this occasion, Dinesh helps it down to fine leg for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Angling into Karthik, helped around the corner for a run.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Karthik shuffles across and punches it to covers. There are four men placed inside the circle on the off side to put pressure on the batsmen.
Short and width on offer, Dhawan slaps but straight to Guptill at backward point.
Shikhar shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide! Boult goes for the slower one but slips it down the leg side, Dhawan fails to put bat on ball.
Fullish delivery outside off, Dhawan goes at it with hard hands and mistimes it to Taylor at short cover.

Good effort, Milne! Full and on the pads, Dhawan clips it beautifully through backward square leg. Milne covers good ground from fine leg, slides to his right and makes a great stop. Saves a couple for his side.
Karthik moves inside the line to the good length delivery and works it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Karthik hangs back and defends it besides the pitch on the leg side.
On a length, angling in from outside off. Dhawan has it covered and offers a straight bat in defense.
Half-volley outside off, Dinesh drives it to Williamson who is standing at the edge of the circle at mid off.
Full length ball on middle, Karthik plays it with soft hands to mid on.
Similar delivery, Dinesh leans ahead and buries it into the track.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Dhawan times his drive nicely to sweeper cover for a run.
Swinging down the leg side, Dhawan looks to whip it away but is struck on the thigh pad.

Time for Drinks. New Zealand have managed to pick up two wickets but India are going along at a healthy run rate and are on track. Dhawan is in rich vein of form and is timing the ball really nicely. The visitors need wickets at consistent intervals or else the game will slip away from them. India need 141 runs from 198 balls with 8 wickets in hand.
Similar length ball, slanting across the right-hander who doesn't flirt with it.
Full length delivery, angling away from Karthik. He shuffles across and blocks it.
Boult errs in line again, slants this one down the leg side and Dhawan tucks it around the corner to rotate strike.
Full length delivery on the pads, Karthik helps it down to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Shikhar punches it nicely to wide mid off for a quick single.
Karthik pokes at a delivery outside off and gets it off the outer half to third man. A run taken.
Trent Boult comes back for a bowl. New Zealand need wickets in quick time and hence, Williamson has brought back his strike bowler.
Good length delivery, Shikhar stays back and punches it to covers.
Makes use of the depth of the crease to place it to point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan stays back and defends it solidly.
Good length ball outside off, dabbed with an open face to point.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Angling into Dhawan who clips it to deep square leg for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Karthik blocks it from within the crease.
Short delivery, Karthik ducks under it.
Shortish delivery outside off, Dinesh goes for an upper cut but is beaten by the pace on it.
Short of a length outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
How did that miss the off stump? Brute of a delivery. Yorker around off, Karthik looks to keep it out but it is too good for him. The ball just misses the off pole, might be by less than an inch.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Deft! Shortish delivery outside off, Karthik dabs it towards short third man where the fielder dives to his right but fails to stop it. He recovers and hares after it but fails to prevent the boundary.
Dinesh Karthik strides out to bat. He played a good knock in the last game.

OUT! The bowling change brings in the reward! De Grandhomme bowls a cross seam delivery on a length outside off. The Indian skipper does the mistake of fishing at it and ends up getting a faint nick. Latham behind the wickets takes a sharp catch. Kohli starts walking off as soon as he edged it. He is angry with himself as he fails to convert a promising start. Can the visitors trigger a collapse now?
Fullish on middle and leg, Dhawan turns it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short and room on offer, Dhawan slaps it past point for a rocketing boundary.
Wide! De Grandhomme loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Dhawan goes for the flick but misses.
Latham comes up to the stumps.
Length delivery, Shikhar hangs back and answers it with a straight bat.
Straying on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a run.
Colin de Grandhomme comes in for a burst. Williamson needs to be creative and keep on shuffling around his bowlers to break this stand.
Coming in from outside off, Dhawan manages to keep it out.
Aggression from Milne! Full length pacy delivery attacking the stumps, Dhawan jams it out to Milne who mimes a throw to the southpaw. The crowd liked it.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Kohli pulls it through square leg for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short of a length on off, Dhawan drops it to point and calls his partner through for a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli runs it down smartly to third man for a single.
Full on middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, milked down to long on for a run.

Another chirpy appeal denied! Arm delivery, skidding off the surface and coming in with the angle. Kohli looks to defend it to the leg side but is struck high on the pads. New Zealand roar in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. All the three stumps were visible and the replays confirm that it was missing the leg stump.
Outside off, tapped with the spin past point for a single.
Flatter delivery, Dhawan hangs back and defends it solidly.
Turns this one with the angle to the leg side for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

A loud appeal for an LBW is turned down! Milne comes around the wicket and angles in a full delivery to Dhawan. He looks to jam it out but seems to have missed it to get rapped on the pads. Milne is confident but the umpire stays put. It is difficult to get an LBW from that angle. The replays confirm that it was going down leg.
Fuller in length around off, eased to covers off the front foot.
Back of a length ball, slanting across Dhawan. He offers a firm punch off the back foot to extra cover. Milne needs to be much fuller, can't afford to offer time and width to Shikhar.
Short and room on offer, Dhawan runs it down to deep backward point. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Good length delivery around off, Dhawan stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Time for Powerplay 2. Four fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Too full, he has been like that throughout the over. Shikhar eases it to long on for a run. Five singles from the over.
Tossed up delivery, Virat makes room and strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full once again, Dhawan milks it to long off to rotate strike.
Makes room and places this delivery to mid off for a swift single.
Full delivery, knocked down to long on for an easy run.
Slow through the air outside off, Dhawan leans into it and eases it to covers.
Change of bowling at both ends. Mitchell Santner is brought onto bowl inside the first Powerplay.
In the zone outside off, the Indian skipper doesn't fiddle with it.
Short of a length outside off, no real movement there. Kohli points his bat skywards and lets it go.

FOUR! Runs are flowing for India! Full length delivery in line of the stumps, Kohli brings his wrists into play and whips it towards wide mid on. Southee runs to his right, dives full length but fails to stop it and the ball races to the fence.
Short of a length outside off, Kohli makes good use of the depth of the crease to block it.
In the zone of apprehension, holding its line. Kohli lets it be.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Adam Milne comes into the attack.
Back of a length outside off, guided to third man for a run. Kohli wants the second but it is not on offer.
SIX! The short ball ploy is not working! Short delivery around off, Kohli shuffles a bit and pulls it with disdain over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Walks across to the good length delivery and looks to turn it around the corner but is struck on the thigh pad.
Fullish on off, shaping in a bit. Kohli covers the line and blocks it.
Back of a length on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
In the channel outside off, Virat lets it be.

Not Out! The decision remains and New Zealand unnecessarily waste their review. Short delivery directed at the body, Dhawan goes for the hook but seems to have missed it. Latham collects it and claims it. Southee is really confident. He walks across to his skipper and convinces him to take the review. The replays roll in. The Snicko doesn't spot any edge or glove on it. However, there was a sound in real time but not sure where it came from.
Review time! New Zealand challenge a decision against Dhawan. After a lot of consultation, they went for it. Seems like there was daylight between bat and ball. Is there a surprise awaiting though?
SIX! Boom! Ominous signs for the visitors. Short delivery on off, comes at a nice height to Dhawan. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Angling into Virat who shuffles across and helps it to mid-wicket for a run.
A deep mid-wicket in place now. Might be a double bluff.
Full length delivery outside off, drawing Kohli to drive but he resists the urge to do so.
FOUR! Right on top of it! Shortish delivery on middle, Kohli swivels across and pulls it through square leg to find the fence. His head position was spot on and the control on the shot too.
Length delivery seaming in from around off, Kohli covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Short of a length outside off, played with an angled blade to backward point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! That's a shot of a man who is really assured about himself! Shortish delivery outside off, Dhawan rises with the bounce and ramps it over the slip cordon for a one bounce boundary.
Wide! Swinging down the leg side, Dhawan tries to clip it away but misses.

Four Leg byes! Slanting down the leg side, Dhawan tries to tickle it away but misses. The ball brushes his thigh pad and goes past the diving Latham and through to the fence. The umpire first signals a boundary but then realizes that he needs to change it to leg byes. Funny moment there.
Fuller in length in the same channel, tapped to cover-point off the front foot.
That's a peach! Bowls it on a length on off and gets it to curl away after pitching. Dhawan feels for it but is foxed completely. The threat of Boult is looming over the Indians.
FOUR! Well played! Full length delivery attacking the stumps, Kohli leans into it and strokes it past mid on for a majestic boundary. A wicket and 11 from that over.
Off the mark in style! Fullish delivery on the pads, Kohli wrists it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Welcomes Kohli with a bouncer who ducks under it.
Virat Kohli comes out to bat. Chants of Kohli Kohli for the Indian skipper.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Rohit must be really disappointed with himself. Fullish delivery on the pads, Sharma goes for the flick but the balance is not quite there. As a result, he is not able to keep the ball down. Colin Munro at squarish short mid-wicket pouches it safely at chest height. Ideal start for New Zealand.
Fullish delivery outside off, Dhawan drives it to mid off for a brisk single.
FOUR! Delightful! Back of a length ball outside off, Dhawan stands tall and times his punch to perfection through cover-point to pick up another boundary.
Plays it with the swing to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Sharma defends it off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, angling away. Inviting the batsman to drive. Rohit obliges but gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, Dhawan guides it down to third man for a run.
Short and outside off, Dhawan chops it to the man at slip.
FOUR! Not the line you want to bowl to Dhawan! Boult angles it on the pads, a batsman of Dhawan's caliber won't miss out on those. He flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Sharma once again leaves it. 11 dot balls out of 12 for Tim Southee.
Fuller in length outside off, Sharma shoulders his arms to it.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Sharma lets it be. A brave leave as that was close to the off pole.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Good length on off, Sharma defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Too easy! Short ball on middle, sits up to be hit. Sharma pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Good length on off, Dhawan defends it off the front foot. 8 runs from the over.

Goes for the yorker but ends up serving a low full toss. Sharma flicks it through mid-wicket. Santner gives it a chase and saves a run for his team. A better throw at the striker's end might have had Dhawan in trouble.
In the channel outside off, Sharma opts not to fiddle with it.
Good length on middle, Sharma defends it solidly.
Good length on off, swinging away. Dhawan tries to defend but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
FOUR! STREAKY! It was there to be hit though! Short ball outside off, Dhawan tries to cut but gets an outside edge over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Trent Boult will bowl with the second new ball. He was brilliant in the last game and New Zealand desperately need him to replicate his heroics.
Full and wide outside off, inviting the batsman to drive. Rohit resists and lets it be. A maiden to start off from Southee.
Fuller in length on off, Sharma pushes it to the man at covers.
He finally makes him play! Southee lands it on a length on off, Rohit prods forward and blocks it.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls closer to the off pole but not close enough to make the batsman play.
Good length outside off stump. The batsman need not play at it.
He lands it on a length around off, shapes away. Rohit watchfully leaves it.
We are all set to get underway for the chase. Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma will open the batting for India. Tim Southee will bowl with the first new ball. He has one slip in place. Here we go...
